notes_for_editor: Record height_m 121.9 (about 400 ft) is not supported by any source I read; it looks wrong for a peak lookout, so I left height out of facts. Please verify before publishing. Record 'standing' is not confirmed by any text read: the register photos run to 2017 and the page does not say whether the cab stands now. The 2026 status is unknown, so the story does not say the cab stands. Access: the Forest Service describes the roads but says nothing about the cab; access level was left out. Sources disagree on forest administration at the summit: the register names the Tahoe, while the Forest Service route page places the road at the Tahoe-Toiyabe junction. Search snippets (not fetched) mentioned an early-1930s first lookout, a boarded-up cab, and differing summit heights (8,431 to 8,455 ft); none was used in the story. The 1958 clipping is from the Reno Evening Gazette as cited on the Forest Lookouts page. Fact-check 2026-10-08: the 1986 survey date is in the register text and now appears in the evidence quote; the 1958 date and Reno Evening Gazette attribution were confirmed on the Forest Lookouts page; the Forest Service page does not use the word 'dirt', so the story and trail note now say OHV routes.
